info.cls_ename: Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch: 掌握英語辯論的基本技巧，了解辯論的基本常識。同時，藉由各種形式的反覆演練，加強學生表達能力、批判性思考能力、快速反應能力、組織能力、辨析能力及各種知識的整合能力。
description.describe_eh: This course provides the foundations of academic debate.  Students will learn the fundamentals of making an argument as well as standard debate procedures. Furthermore, through class discussion, group work, research and brief writing, practice with the public debate format, flowing (note-taking during debates), practice with both affirmative and negative positions, and judging a debate, the course will strengthen students' skills in the areas of critical thinking, open-mindedness, quick thinking, organization, analysis, and teamwork.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
a. Absences 
Absences are excused if the student informs the teacher by e-mail, MyFCU system, or in-person before the missed class. All absence requests must be written in English. All other absences will be marked as unexcused, except in the case of an emergency. Students are responsible for informing their group members of any absence during class practice time, and if they fail to do so, will have points deducted from their attendance grade. It is the student’s responsibility to make up any missed work by contacting the class helper or a classmate. If students are late to class more than 10 minutes, they will have points deducted from their attendance grade. If students are absent for ½ of the class, they will have ½ an absence. If students are never late and have no absences, they will receive extra credit.

b. Participation
Students are expected to arrive on time and prepared for each class time. Students will receive point deductions for attending class late, using a cell phone during class time without permission, sleeping during class time, failing to bring class materials, failing to speak English for the majority of class time, or using disrespectful language towards the teacher or classmates. Students must bring this paper and a notebook to every class time. Students may eat in class if it is not disruptive to their and/or others’ learning. Students do not need to ask the instructor to go to the bathroom.

c. Make-ups
If a student has an excused absence for any assignment day, then they may complete their assignment on an alternative class date according to the instructor. If a student has an unexcused absence on an assignment day, then they will receive a zero. There are no make-up group presentations for unexcused absences. If a student has an excused absence for a group presentation, then they must communicate with the instructor about how to have a make-up grade. 

d. iLearn 
Students are required to check their iLearn for course materials. 
   
e. Student-Teacher Conferences 
This conference is an informal one-on-one chat with the instructor. Students may discuss any questions related to this course, future study/work/travel goals, American culture, politics, or hobbies, etc. This assignment is OPTIONAL and will count as extra credit points to your lowest Homework/Participation grade.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: Contact the instructor in person or via email if you have any issues (job schedule, family events, trips) throughout the semester that might impact your attendance, participation, or group work. Communicate with the instructor if you need extra time or accommodations for any assignment. If you plan to drop this course, please inform the instructor. If any of the debate topics make you feel uncomfortable, please inform the instructor in order to change topics. If you want to achieve a high score in this course, participation is key!
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Any assignment partially or fully copied from the internet or other sources (ChatGPT, classmates, textbooks, etc.) will receive a zero. If the student is not truthful or forthcoming in this situation, then they may need to complete another assignment in front of the instructor. All students must participate as equally as possible in group assignments. If any student fails to participate equally in group assignments, their grade will be individualized. If students have any issue with other group members, they should inform the instructor as soon as possible in order to find a solution.
